parsed_response.reasoning: The diff shows `minimumTokenResponseSchema = z.object({ access_token: z.string(), [z.string().toString()]: z.number(), [z.string().optional().toString()]: z.unknown().optional() })`. Zod schema instances do not override toString, so both computed keys evaluate to "[object Object]"; the second entry silently overwrites the expiry (z.number()) validation, meaning token responses are validated by an arbitrary/duplicate key rather than any expiry property, and TS type safety degrades to an index signature. The schema therefore does not enforce the expiry field the comment claims ('Assume that any property with a number is the expiry'). This is a verifiable correctness defect in newly added code (parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts) that also mutates refreshTokenResponse.data when data is a plain object.

judged_text: minimumTokenResponseSchema's computed keys [z.string().toString()] and [z.string().optional().toString()] (parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:4-9) both evaluate to the literal string '[object Object]' because zod schemas don't override toString — the duplicate key lets z.unknown().optional() silently replace the intended expiry validation, the schema's comments describe behavior that does not exist, and the non-literal computed keys degrade the TS type to an index signature, erasing type safety for every caller.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` attempts to model “any numeric property is expiry” and “allow other properties” using computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. In JS object literals these computed keys become a single literal property name (derived from the Zod object’s `toString()`), not a dynamic/index signature, and the second entry overwrites the first if they resolve to the same string. As a result, the schema does not actually validate arbitrary numeric expiry fields as the comments claim, and instead effectively degrades to (at best) one fixed extra property definition. This is a concrete correctness issue in the new schema used when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is on.
